Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment uses a substrate-trapping strategy (DMOG) combined with AP-MS to identify hydroxylase substrates. While the study focuses on hydroxylation (a PTM), the primary enrichment method is affinity purification (AP-MS) of the enzyme-substrate complex rather than a chemical PTM-enrichment (like TiO2). The search parameters specifically include a wide array of oxidations to facilitate the identification of hydroxylation sites.

The hydroxylation screen requires a broad set of oxidation variable modifications (MWYFKPHDN) to capture the +15.99 Da shift on multiple residues (Proline, Asparagine, etc.) without a specific enrichment reagent.
